column6: Structural particle 得 (as in 跑得快) is neutral tone: de, not dé — dé/děi are the other readings of this character but don't fit "after a verb" here.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on the second syllable: gàosu, not gàosù.
As the experiential-aspect particle after a verb (e.g. 去过), 过 is neutral tone: guo, not guò. Contrast with 着 (h2w143 in chunk 2), which the same source already gave correctly as neutral "zhe".
